instruction: How many songs from across my spotify song and album libraries were released before this year?
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes are required (evaluation checks no model changes), so all actions are lookups. library-song / library-album are representative objects standing for every item of the paginated song and album libraries; at runtime spotify.show_song is repeated for each library song id (album library entries already expose release_date and song_ids, so no show_album is needed). phone.get_current_date_and_time (no login needed) supplies the current year used as the 'before this year' threshold (release_date < 2023-01-01). The answer object count-songs-before-this-year is computed at runtime as the number of unique song ids across both filtered sets and passed as the answer to supervisor.complete_task, which is forced to be last via the (task-completed) guard on every action. The song and album parameters of supervisor-complete-task are task records (not API arguments) used only to instantiate the goal conditions.
